architecture: deterministic schema-validator floor (L1 type / L2 required / L3 enum-range-format) + LLM ceiling (L4 semantic-contract, L5 intent-vs-action). The floor is mechanical + infallible at serve time; the LLM does the reasoning rungs.
exam_split: tool-atomic (the 10 exam tools never appear in training) — measures GENERALIZATION, not memorization
caveat: GENERALIZES to unseen tools (0.98/0.96 on a tool-atomic held-out exam) — the first new mint that did (contrast with verifier-v2's voice fix, which did not transfer OOD). Weak spot: L4 semantic-contract (0.9 acc / 0.8 flip / 2 false-conformants of 10 at-risk) — the pure-reasoning rung the deterministic floor can't cover, and where the safety-critical misses concentrate. v0.2 target = more + more-diverse L4 (semantic-contract) data. Deploy INTERNAL-FIRST, advisory + fail-open, PAIRED with the deterministic schema-validator floor (which catches all L1-L3 mechanically).
rollback: v1 (no prior version); compensator = disable the consult flag (the watcher is advisory + fail-open, so it cannot block a dispatch).
notes: Minted via the proven recipe (Qwen3-14B QLoRA, rsLoRA r16/alpha32, lr 1e-4, batch2/accum8 — halved from batch4 for the long tool-schema sequences that OOM'd at 98% VRAM; soup of seeds 42+1337). Dataset: role-os/tools/conformance-dataset/ (66 tools across 8 domains, contrast-group + flip-consistency, audit-gated, exam=100). Corpus scaled via wf_c890b004-c8f (cross-family-verified).
